w: “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
k: Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

w: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
k: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

w: “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?”
“Tend my sheep.”
k: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me?Feed my sheep.

w: “Children, have you anything to eat?”
k: Children, have ye any meat?

w: “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
k: If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

w: “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?”
“Feed my lambs.”
k: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these?Feed my lambs.

w: “Follow me.”
k: Follow me.

w: “Come and eat breakfast.”
k: Come and dine.

w: “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?”
“Do you have affection for me?”
“Feed my sheep.
k: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me?Feed my sheep.

w: “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.”
k: Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find.

w: “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
k: If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

w: “I am thirsty.”
k: I thirst.

w: “Behold, your mother!”
k: Behold thy mother!

w: “It is finished.”
k: It is finished:

w: “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
k: Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

w: “Woman, behold, your son!”
k: Woman, behold thy son!

w: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
k: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

w: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
k: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

w: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.”
k: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light.

w: “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
k: The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

w: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
k: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

w: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
k: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

w: “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
k: Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

w: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
k: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

w: “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
k: This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

w: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
k: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

w: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
k: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

w: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

w: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
k: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

w: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I came to this time.
k: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

w: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
k: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

w: “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
k: He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

w: “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
k: Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

w: ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’
k: The Son of man must be lifted up?

w: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
k: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

w: Father, glorify your name!”
k: Father, glorify thy name.

w: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
k: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

w: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
k: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

w: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
k: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

w: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God?’
k: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

w: “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
k: I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

w: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
k: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

w: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
k: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

w: I and the Father are one.”
k: I and my Father are one.

w: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
k: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

w: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
k: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

w: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

w: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
k: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

w: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
k: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

w: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life,
that I may take it again.
k: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

w: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
k: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

w: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.
k: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

w: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
k: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

w: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold.
I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
k: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

w: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
k: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

w: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
k: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

w: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.
k: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

w: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
k: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

w: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
k: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

w: I am the good shepherd.
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
k: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

w: “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

w: “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’
k: Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

w: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn’t care for the sheep.
k: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

w: “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
k: Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

w: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
k: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

w: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
k: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

w: “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
k: Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

w: “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
k: Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

w: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
k: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

w: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
k: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

w: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
k: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

w: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
k: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

w: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
k: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

w: “Do you know what I have done to you?
k: Know ye what I have done to you?

w: “What you do, do quickly.”
k: That thou doest, do quickly.

w: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
k: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

w: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

w: “You are not all clean.”
k: Ye are not all clean.

w: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
k: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

w: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
k: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

w: “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
k: If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

w: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
k: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

w: “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
k: He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

w: “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
k: Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

w: “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.”
k: He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it.

w: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
k: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

w: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

w: “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
k: What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

w: “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

w: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
k: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

w: They will do these things
because they have not known the Father, nor me.
k: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

w: ‘A little while’

A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
k: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

w: “Do you now believe?
k: Do ye now believe?

w: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,
k: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

w: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
k: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

w: “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’
k: Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

w: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
k: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

w: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
k: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

w: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
k: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

w: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
k: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

w: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
k: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

w: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
k: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

w: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
k: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

w: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
k: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

w: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
k: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

w: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
k: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

w: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
k: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

w: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes
of mine, and will declare it to you.
k: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

w: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

w: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
k: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

w: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
k: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

w: “I have yet many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
k: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

w: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
k: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

w: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
k: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

w: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
k: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

w: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
k: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

w: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
k: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

w: ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’
‘Because I go to the Father’
I came from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.”
k: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

w: “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
k: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

w: “Do you want to be made well?”
k: Wilt thou be made whole?

w: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
k: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

w: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
k: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

w: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
k: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

w: “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

w: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
k: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

w: Most certainly, I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

w: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
k: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

w: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
k: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

w: “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
k: Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

w: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
k: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

w: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
k: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

w: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
k: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

w: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

w: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
k: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

w: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
k: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

w: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,
k: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

w: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
k: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

w: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
k: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

w: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
k: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

w: ‘Take up your mat, and walk.’
k: Take up thy bed, and walk.

w: ‘Take up your mat, and walk’
k: Take up thy bed, and walk?

w: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
k: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

w: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
k: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

w: You don’t have his word living in you; because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
k: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

w: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
k: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

w: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
k: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

w: I don’t receive glory from men.
k: I receive not honour from men.

w: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
k: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

w: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
k: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

w: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
k: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

w: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
k: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

w: “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
k: My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

w: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
k: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

w: “Come, and see.”
k: Come and see.

w: “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
k: Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

w: “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

w: “Follow me.”
k: Follow me.

w: “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
k: Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

w: “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas”
k: Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas,

w: “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
k: Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

w: “What are you looking for?”
k: What seek ye?

w: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
k: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

w: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
k: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

w: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
k: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

w: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.
k: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

w: “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

w: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
k: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

w: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
k: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

w: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

w: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.
k: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

w: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
k: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

w: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
k: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

w: “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew,
he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
k: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

w: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
k: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

w: The wind
blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
k: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

w: “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
k: Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

w: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
k: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

w: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
k: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

w: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
k: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

w: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
k: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

w: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
k: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

w: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
k: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

w: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
k: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

w: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.
k: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

w: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
k: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

w: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
k: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

w: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
k: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

w: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
k: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

w: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
k: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

w: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
k: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

w: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
k: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

w: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
k: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

w: “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
k: Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

w: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
k: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

w: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
k: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

w: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
k: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

w: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
k: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

w: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
k: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

w: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.
k: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

w: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you, and they have believed that you sent me.
k: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

w: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
k: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

w: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
k: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

w: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
k: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

w: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
k: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

w: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.
k: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

w: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
k: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

w: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
k: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

w: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
k: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

w: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
k: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

w: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
k: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

w: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
k: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

w: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
k: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

w: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
k: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

w: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
k: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

w: “When the Counselor
has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
k: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

w: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
k: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

w: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
k: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

w: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
k: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

w: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
k: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

w: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
k: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

w: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
k: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

w: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.
k: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

w: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
k: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

w: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
k: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

w: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
k: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

w: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
k: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

w: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
k: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

w: “In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
k: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

w: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’
If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
k: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

w: But all these things will they do to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
k: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

w: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
k: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

w: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said.”
k: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

w: “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
k: Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

w: “Who are you looking for?”
k: Whom seek ye?

w: “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
k: Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

w: “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
k: I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

w: “I am he.”
k: I am

w: “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
k: My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

w: “Who are you looking for?”
k: Whom seek ye?

w: “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
k: Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

w: “I am he,”
k: I am he,

w: “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
k: If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

w: “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
k: Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

w: “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
k: I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

w: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
k: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.

w: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.
k: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

w: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
k: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

w: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
k: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

w: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
k: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

w: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.
k: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

w: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
k: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

w: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
k: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

w: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
k: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

w: You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
k: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

w: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
k: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

w: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
k: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

w: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
k: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

w: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
k: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

w: “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
k: Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

w: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

w: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
k: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

w: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
k: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

w: Where I go, you know, and you know the way.”
k: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

w: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
k: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

w: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
k: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

w: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.
k: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

w: “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
k: I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

w: If you love me, keep my commandments.
k: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

w: “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.
k: If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

w: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
k: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

w: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
k: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

w: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor,
that he may be with you forever,—
k: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

w: “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
k: Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

w: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
k: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

w: “Go your way. Your son lives.”
k: Go thy way; thy son liveth.

w: “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
k: Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

w: “Your son lives.”
k: Thy son liveth:

w: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
k: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

w: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
k: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

w: “My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.
k: My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

w: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
k: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

w: “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.
k: Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

w: “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
k: I that speak unto thee am he.

w: “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
k: Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

w: “Give me a drink.”
k: Give me to drink.

w: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
k: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

w: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
k: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

w: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
k: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

w: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest?’ Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
k: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

w: “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
k: If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

w: “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
k: I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

w: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
k: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

w: “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
k: Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

w: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
k: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

w: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
k: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

w: “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
k: If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

w: “I am the light of the world.
He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
k: I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

w: “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
k: Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

w: “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
k: I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

w: “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
k: If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

w: ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’
k: Whither I go, ye cannot come.

w: “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
k: If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

w: “You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
k: Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

w: You do the works of your father.”
k: Ye do the deeds of your father.

w: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

w: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
k: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

w: “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

w: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
k: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

w: “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
k: He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

w: ‘You will be made free’
k: Ye shall be made free?

w: “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
k: Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

w: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.”
k: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

w: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
k: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

w: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am
he, you will die in your sins.”
k: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

w: “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

w: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
k: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

w: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
k: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

w: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
k: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

w: “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
k: Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

w: “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
k: When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

w: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
k: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

w: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.
k: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

w: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
k: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

w: “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
k: If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

w: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
k: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

w: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
k: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

w: “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
k: Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

w: “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
k: I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

w: ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
k: If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

w: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
k: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

w: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
k: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

w: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
k: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

w: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
k: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

w: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
k: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

w: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
k: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

w: “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
k: Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

w: “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

w: ‘I have come down out of heaven?’”
k: I came down from heaven?

w: “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
k: Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

w: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.
k: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

w: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
k: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

w: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
k: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

w: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
k: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

w: “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.
k: I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

w: “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
k: This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

w: “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
k: I am the bread which came down from heaven.

w: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
k: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

w: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
k: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

w: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
k: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

w: “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
k: Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

w: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
k: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

w: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

w: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
k: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

w: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
k: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

w: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
k: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

w: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
k: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

w: “Does this cause you to stumble?
k: Doth this offend you?

w: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
k: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

w: “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
k: Will ye also go away?

w: “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
k: Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

w: “Have the people sit down.”
k: Make the men sit down.

w: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
k: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

w: “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
k: Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

w: I am the bread of life.
k: I am that bread of life.

w: But there are some of you who don’t believe.”
k: But there are some of you that believe not.

w: “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

w: “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
k: Murmur not among yourselves.

w: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
k: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

w: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
k: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

w: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
k: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

w: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
k: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

w: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’
Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.
k: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

w: “It is I.
Don’t be afraid.”
k: It is I; be not afraid.

w: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
k: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

w: “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

w: “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?”
k: Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou?

w: “Peace be to you.”
k: Peace be unto you.

w: “Because you have seen me,
you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.”
k: Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

w: “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
k: Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

w: “Peace be to you.”
k: Peace be unto you.

w: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
k: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

w: “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
k: Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

w: “Mary.”
k: Mary.

w: “Receive the Holy Spirit!
k: Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

w: “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
k: reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

w: ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me; and where I am, you can’t come’
k: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

w: “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
k: My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

w: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.
k: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

w: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
k: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

w: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
k: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

w: You will seek me, and won’t find me; and where I am, you can’t come.”
k: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

w: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
k: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

w: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
k: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

w: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
k: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

w: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
k: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

w: “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
k: If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

w: “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
k: Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

w: “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
k: Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

w: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
k: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

w: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
k: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

w: “I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.
k: I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

w: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
k: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

w: “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
k: My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

w: “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
k: If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

w: ‘Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.’
k: Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash:

w: “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
k: Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

w: “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
k: Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

w: “Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
k: Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

w: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
k: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

w: “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam”
k: Go, wash in the pool of Siloam,

w: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
k: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

w: “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
k: For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

w: “Take away the stone.”
k: Take ye away the stone.

w: “Where have you laid him?”
k: Where have ye laid him?

w: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
k: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

w: “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
k: This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

w: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
k: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

w: “Free him, and let him go.”
k: Loose him, and let him go.

w: “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
k: Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

w: “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
k: I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

w: “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
k: Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

w: “Lazarus is dead.
k: Lazarus is dead.

w: “Lazarus, come out!”
k: Lazarus, come forth.

w: “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
k: Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

w: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
k: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

w: “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
k: Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

w: “Your brother will rise again.”
k: Thy brother shall rise again.

w: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
k: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

w: “Let’s go into Judea again.”
k: Let us go into Judaea again.

w: “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
k: Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

w: “Fill the water pots with water.”
k: Fill the waterpots with water.

w: “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
k: Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

w: “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
k: Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.

w: “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.”
k: Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast.
